rules: Every ability is taught by exactly one named item (Taught By). Scrolls teach bending, weapons teach weapon arts. A hero has a single learning slot: only the item in that slot earns AP toward its ability.
An ability can be learned once you meet its Mastery Required AND have mastered every ability listed in Prerequisites.
Prerequisites like 'Air Mastery 350' mean you also need 350 Mastery in a second tree. These are the cross-element abilities (Lightning, Lavabending, Sandstorm, Steam...).
Damage, healing, shield size, duration and charges scale with the tree's Mastery stat plus the stat in Scales With.
Each tree has 20–23 abilities. A specialist who masters one tree and goes deep in a second (e.g. Fire + Sword) knows about 30.
Add a row, give it a new ID (e.g. F22), pick Tree and Tier from the dropdowns, and copy the Mastery Required formula down from the row above.
Write prerequisite ability names separated by semicolons, exactly as spelled in the Ability column.
Cooldowns are starting values for playtesting — edit freely.
Row color = tree. Filter by Tree, Branch or Tier with the header arrows.
Pick a unit; locks on and can't miss. Limits: range, line of sight, and any cast time the target can escape.
Aim at an enemy or a direction; the shot locks on release and travels along a tile line (any angle, or 8-way where noted). Misses if the target moved.
Pick a tile; the area is telegraphed before it goes off so units can step out.
Centered on or affecting the caster; no aiming.
A skillshot or telegraph is only dodgeable if its warning time is longer than the step cooldown plus ~0.3s reaction.
Mastering an ability (full AP) grants a one-time Mastery bonus in its tree (Mastery on Learn).
Each use against an enemy at or near your level adds Mastery per Use, until that ability has contributed its Mastery Cap in total.

Tier 1: +5, +0.2, cap 50 | Tier 2: +10, +0.3, cap 70 | Tier 3: +15, +0.4, cap 100 | Tier 4: +25, +0.5, cap 150 | Tier 5: +50, +1, cap 200. Per-use gain is multiplied by cooldown so slow abilities keep pace: x2 for 10–29s, x4 for 30–89s, x10 for 90s+. All values are per row and editable.
Tier 1 caps total 200, enough to reach Tier 2 (150). Tiers 1–2 reach Tier 3 (350); Tiers 1–3 reach Tier 4 (600); Tiers 1–4 reach Tier 5 (900). A hero must use a tree's abilities to climb it.
